name: DBS Vantage Visa Infinite Card

highlights: Earn 2.2 miles per dollar on all eligible overseas spend. Earn 1.5 miles per dollar on all eligible local spend.
pros: 1.5 miles or 1.5% cashback per S$1 spent locally, such as groceries, shopping and more.
pros: 2.2 miles or 2.2% cashback per S$1 spent on overseas purchases in foreign currency.
pros: Receive 25,000 bonus miles when you pay the annual fee of S$550 (exclusive of GST) to renew your membership.
pros: Complimentary Accor Plus Explorer membership with 1 free hotel night stay at Sofitel, Fairmont, Swissotel and over 1000 hotels worldwide.
pros: Complimentary Digital Priority Pass™ Membership and 10 free lounge visits to over 1,300 airport lounges worldwide within each 12-month period of membership.
pros: Members-only dining privileges at over 80 of Singapore’s fine dining establishments, including Michelin-awarded restaurants.
cons: Annual fee of S$588.50 (inclusive of GST) is non-waivable for the first year.
cons: Miles are awarded in the form of DBS Points which are awarded for every S$5 spent.
cons: Each conversion of DBS Points to miles will be subjected to an administrative fee of S$25 (exclusive of GST).

extra.description: The DBS Vantage Visa Infinite Card is for the seasoned traveller, offering 2.2mpd on foreign currency spend, along with a whopping 10 complimentary airport lounge visits per year!
